title: Library Management System reference design
architecture: Keep domain types and core rules separate from console/file/network/UI adapters.
Use standard containers and RAII-owned resources unless a measured requirement justifies a lower-level abstraction.
Represent invalid states and failures explicitly; do not silently ignore failed I/O or dependency operations.
implementation_plan: Test unavailable books and invalid returns
test_plan: I/O or dependency failure where relevant
expected_quality: Track books and lending activity. Include a README, explicit C++ standard and build commands, known limitations, and reproducible test results.
explanation: This reference design shows a review path for Library Management System; it is not represented as a complete source implementation. Fill in and review the domain-specific implementation and tests before publication.
